made_by: by hand, from the numbers measured on the 8 private images (2026-11-17); not computed by src.calibration_card
source: 8 optical micrographs of a coarse elongated cell structure with hand-corrected masks (private; only these numbers were shared)

notes.boundary_fraction: about 10 % of the image (boundaries drawn 2-3 px wide)
notes.transverse_boundaries: the end-to-end (transverse) boundaries are not fainter than those along the cells
notes.scratches: hairline scratches at ~45 deg to the cells; a thick dark scratch ~20 deg off the cell direction
notes.cell_width_variation: within an image cell widths vary by about 2x (thin slivers to wide lenses)
notes.inclusions: elongated grey or dark lens-shaped inclusions in the boundaries, 10-60 px long, 3-10 px wide
notes.pockets: dark grey speckled clusters at some triple junctions, 20-80 px across
notes.dots: dark round pores 3-15 px inside cells, a few black blobs up to ~25 px; a sparse fine speckle of 1-3 px specks
notes.interiors: almost white and flat, near saturation
